audit_notes: Do not list general Sun–Wang construction, its torus case, and its fattening pair as three distinct catalogue examples; the latter are one entry here.
The high-genus spherical-doubling translator is an explicit application of SW to the independently constructed KM input, not a separately named theorem in SW.
One time-slice end is inferred from compact core and connected product end; the two-sided R factor in backward cylinder does not mean two translator ends.
Neither total translator has surface genus. Torus cross-section genus1 and spherical-doubling cross-section genus2m−1 belong in separate metadata fields.
I_A and I_m are Gaussian indices of input shrinkers, not weighted indices of the minimizing translators, and include translation parameters.
All I-uniqueness/stability claims are restricted to the weighted minimizing class; no entropy stability, unrestricted uniqueness, or global core classification is inferred.
The closed-set fattening theorem does not by itself prove level-set fattening from smooth compact initial data.
No source assets or papers are to be copied into public site exports.
Møller preprint was inspected for audit only. Existing catalogue unchanged; no independently verified journal version found.
SW PDF5/HTML scalar-sign definitions contain an apparent inconsistency. Use its invariant vector equation (2.5), which matches the catalogue upward convention.
KM publisher access returned403; all page and theorem locators clearly identify arXiv v4, never guessed published pages.
SS19 defines its displayed vector with the opposite sign to the project; its actual evolution is d_t X=Delta X, so formulas need no sign alteration.
The radius exponents are k_j squared, not k_j. The time relation uses 2*k_j squared, not (2*k_j) squared.
For compact torus curves the chosen k1=1 subfamily is embedded. It is one-dimensional, so surface genus does not apply.
No claim that source conjecture2.4 codimension lower bounds are theorems.
No use of the broadly worded ambient-dimension Theorem2.8 beyond actual displayed constructions.
AAAW13 Section3 was checked for priority, but no time-integral coefficients from its preprint are copied; formulas are checked from SS19 and by direct differentiation.
Helix sup-in-time entropy is infinite; do not assign infinite entropy to every slice.
Fixed-center F01 formulas were independently integrated from exact parametrizations at the root agent request, and are not identified with lambda.
CS26R3 contains occasional prose calling the flow eternal, but the proved constructed time domain is [0,infinity); catalogue says immortal only.
CS26R3 initial datum is locally Lipschitz; smooth for positive time. Positive-time shift gives a smooth starting surface.
Genus and ends of Chen–Sun families are marked direct consequences of parametrizations, not falsely attributed to named topology theorems.
CS25Man has real ambient dimension n+1, even though the product is isometrically embedded in R^(n+2). The Euclidean drawing does not satisfy unforced Euclidean MCF.
CS25Man manifold is the standard round product, not an unspecified warped product and not the round sphere S^(n+1).
No exact entropy, finite-time Gaussian area, stability classification, or quantitative neck-collapse rates are fabricated for either Chen–Sun construction.
No PDFs, extracted texts, or source-page PNGs may be copied into public exports.
KKM v3 has a homothety factor sqrt(2(1-t)) alongside the equation H=<X,nu>/2. The equation and radius2 cap are decisive; use M_t=sqrt(-t)*Sigma, not that factor.

Ketover v2 equation (1.7) has the same displayed scalar sign as shrinker equation (1.1) while describing an expander. Do not copy it for an expander catalogue; this review adds no expander from that display.

Ketover page4 notes Ilmanen-White construct presumably the same family with two ends for all genera; without reading and identifying the original family do not transfer that all-genus end count to Ketover.
BNS Conjecture1.4 is the DIFFERENT sphere-cylinder limiting family with odd genus and two ends; Ketover doubled-plane family does not automatically prove that specific conjecture.
BNS Table1 labels expected numerical geometries. No certified identification of a numerical surface with a unique min-max output.
Original papers were downloaded and hashed privately. Only newly written paraphrases/formulas and bibliographic links may enter site exports.
